data.one_liner: Drop-in wrapper for video_player that caches videos for offline playback.
data.what_it_does: Extends the video_player plugin to seamlessly cache videos on the device for offline playback and zero buffering on repeat views. Provides pre-caching, custom cache keys, and cache management tools.
use_when: You want to cache network videos to reduce bandwidth and eliminate buffering on repeat views.
You need a drop-in replacement for video_player with offline support.
avoid_when: You need to stream HLS (.m3u8), DASH, or live streams.
You are targeting platforms where video playback requires additional workarounds unless you implement them.
strengths: Zero buffering on repeat views via local caching.
Pre-caching support to download videos before playback.
Custom cache keys and easy cache clearing mechanisms.
weaknesses: Does not support HLS (.m3u8), DASH, or live streams.
Requires dependency overrides for certain platforms or specific bug fixes in underlying packages like flutter_cache_manager.
Windows and Linux require additional packages for video playback.
data.setup_notes: Follow setup instructions for video_player and handle platform-specific dependencies (such as video_player_win or video_player_media_kit for Windows/Linux if required). May need dependency overrides for flutter_cache_manager or get_storage in certain scenarios.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want the official video player without third-party caching logic or dependencies.
